get_password: SELECT password from users WHERE user_id = %s
get_user: SELECT u.group_uuid, u.user_uuid, u.user_id, u.user_name, us.storage_uuid, s.storage_name, s.storage_type FROM users u JOIN user_storages us ON u.user_uuid = us.user_uuid JOIN storages s ON s.storage_uuid = us.storage_uuid WHERE u.user_id = %s AND us.is_default = 1

documents.get_next_number: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM documents WHERE doc_id LIKE ?
documents.get_documents_by_group_id: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE group_id = ? ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
documents.get_documents_by_target_id: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE target_id = ? ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC
documents.get_all_documents: SELECT * FROM documents ORDER BY id DESC
documents.get_documents_by_status: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE status = ? ORDER BY id DESC
documents.get_open_documents: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE status = 'open' ORDER BY id DESC
documents.get_outbox_documents: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE type IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
documents.get_inbox_process_documents: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE type IN (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
documents.get_recently_closed_or_rejected_document: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE status IN ('closed', 'rejected') ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT ?
documents.get_rejected_documents: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE status = 'rejected' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC
documents.get_latest_t_number_in_group: SELECT doc_id FROM documents WHERE group_id = ? AND type = 'T'
documents.get_latest_ds_in_group: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE group_id = ? AND type = 'DS' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
documents.get_latest_d_in_group: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE group_id = ? AND type = 'D' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
documents.insert_document: INSERT INTO documents (doc_id, type, project, module, target_id, group_id, owner, priority, due_date, title, status, next, direction, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
documents.update_document_status: UPDATE documents SET status = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE doc_id = ?
documents.update_document_status_by_pk: UPDATE documents SET status = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?
documents.update_document_metadata: UPDATE documents SET owner = ?, priority = ?, due_date = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE doc_id = ?
documents.set_review_required: UPDATE documents SET review_required = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE doc_id = ?
documents.set_superseded_by: UPDATE documents SET superseded_by = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE doc_id = ?
documents.set_triggered_by: UPDATE documents SET triggered_by = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE doc_id = ?
documents.get_pending_nr_tr_documents: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE status = 'open' AND type IN ('N', 'T') ORDER BY id DESC
documents.get_linked_result_documents: SELECT d.doc_id, d.type, d.status, d.title, d.created_at, d.target_id, e.memo_file FROM documents d LEFT JOIN events e ON e.doc_id = d.doc_id AND e.event_type = 'created' WHERE d.type IN ('NR', 'TR') ORDER BY d.id DESC
documents.get_next_outbox_seq: SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM documents WHERE group_id = ? AND type = ?
documents.get_active_tv_for_t: SELECT d.* FROM documents d JOIN tv_status ts ON ts.tv_doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE d.target_id = ? AND d.type = 'TV' ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT 1
documents.get_previous_active_tv: SELECT d.* FROM documents d WHERE d.type = 'TV' AND d.target_id = ? AND d.doc_id != ? AND (d.superseded_by IS NULL OR d.superseded_by = '') ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT 1

events.insert_event: INSERT INTO events (doc_id, event_type, memo_file, file_hash, reason, related_doc_id, related_target_id, note, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
events.get_created_memo_file: SELECT memo_file FROM events WHERE doc_id = ? AND event_type = 'created' AND memo_file IS NOT NULL AND memo_file != '' ORDER BY event_id DESC LIMIT 1
events.is_file_processed: SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE memo_file = ? AND event_type = 'created' LIMIT 1
events.is_hash_processed: SELECT 1 FROM events WHERE file_hash = ? AND event_type = 'created' LIMIT 1
events.get_events_by_doc_id: SELECT * FROM events WHERE doc_id = ? ORDER BY event_id DESC
events.get_recent_events_by_doc_id: SELECT * FROM events WHERE doc_id = ? ORDER BY event_id DESC LIMIT ?
events.get_recent_events: SELECT * FROM events ORDER BY event_id DESC LIMIT ?
events.get_conflict_events: SELECT * FROM events WHERE event_type = 'conflict_detected' ORDER BY event_id DESC LIMIT ?

groups.issue_group_id: SELECT value FROM id_counter WHERE counter_key = ?
groups.get_all_groups: SELECT * FROM groups ORDER BY created_at DESC
groups.get_groups_by_status: SELECT * FROM groups WHERE status = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC
groups.insert_group: INSERT INTO groups (group_id, project, module, title, priority, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
groups.update_group_status: UPDATE groups SET status = ?, closed_at = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE group_id = ?
groups.update_group_updated_at: UPDATE groups SET updated_at = ? WHERE group_id = ?
groups.close_group: UPDATE groups SET status = ?, closed_at = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE group_id = ?

project_settings.get_project_settings: SELECT project, docs_root, project_root, updated_at FROM project_settings ORDER BY project
project_settings.upsert_project_settings: INSERT INTO project_settings (project, docs_root, project_root, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT(project) DO UPDATE SET docs_root = excluded.docs_root, project_root = excluded.project_root, updated_at = excluded.updated_at

allowed_projects.get_allowed_projects: SELECT project_id AS project, project_name, '' AS module FROM projects WHERE is_active = 1 ORDER BY project_id
allowed_projects.get_allowed_project_names: SELECT project_id AS project FROM projects WHERE is_active = 1
allowed_projects.add_allowed_project: INSERT INTO projects (project_id, project_name, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, 1, datetime('now'), datetime('now')) ON CONFLICT(project_id) DO UPDATE SET is_active = 1, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE projects.is_active = 0
allowed_projects.remove_allowed_project: UPDATE projects SET is_active = 0, updated_at = datetime('now') WHERE project_id = ?

tv_scenarios.get_tv_scenarios: SELECT * FROM tv_scenarios WHERE tv_doc_id = ? ORDER BY scenario_idx ASC
tv_scenarios.insert_tv_scenario: INSERT INTO tv_scenarios (tv_doc_id, scenario_idx, source, title, result, note, disabled, disabled_reason, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
tv_scenarios.update_tv_scenario_result: UPDATE tv_scenarios SET result = ?, note = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE tv_doc_id = ? AND scenario_idx = ?
tv_scenarios.update_tv_scenario_hold_to_skip: UPDATE tv_scenarios SET result = 'skip', note = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE tv_doc_id = ? AND scenario_idx = ? AND result = 'hold'
tv_scenarios.disable_tv_scenario: UPDATE tv_scenarios SET disabled = 1, disabled_reason = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE tv_doc_id = ? AND scenario_idx = ?
tv_scenarios.get_max_scenario_idx: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(scenario_idx), 0) AS max_idx FROM tv_scenarios WHERE tv_doc_id = ?

tv_views.get_active_tv_for_t: SELECT d.* FROM documents d WHERE d.target_id = ? AND d.type = 'TV' AND d.status IN ('open', 'running', 'pass', 'fail', 'reject') ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT 1
tv_views.get_active_tvs_by_statuses: SELECT d.* FROM documents d WHERE d.type = 'TV' AND d.status IN (?) ORDER BY d.id DESC
tv_views.get_tv_tvr_chain_tvs: SELECT d.* FROM documents d WHERE d.target_id = ? AND d.type = 'TV' ORDER BY d.id ASC
tv_views.get_tv_tvr_chain_tvrs: SELECT * FROM documents WHERE target_id = ? AND type = 'TVR' ORDER BY id ASC
tv_views.get_running_tv_in_env: SELECT d.* FROM documents d WHERE d.project = ? AND d.module = ? AND d.type = 'TV' AND d.status IN ('open', 'running') ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT 1
tv_views.get_previous_active_tv: SELECT d.* FROM documents d WHERE d.type = 'TV' AND d.target_id = ? AND d.doc_id != ? AND (d.superseded_by IS NULL OR d.superseded_by = '') ORDER BY d.id DESC LIMIT 1
tv_views.extract_tv_status: SELECT d.doc_id as tv_doc_id, CASE WHEN d.status = 'open' THEN 'Open' WHEN d.status = 'running' THEN 'Running' WHEN d.status = 'pass' THEN 'Pass' WHEN d.status = 'fail' THEN 'Fail' WHEN d.status = 'reject' THEN 'Reject' ELSE d.status END as tv_status, COALESCE(json_extract(d.meta, '$.progress_done'), 0) as progress_done, COALESCE(json_extract(d.meta, '$.progress_total'), 0) as progress_total FROM documents d WHERE d.type = 'TV' AND d.doc_id = ?

questions.insert_question: INSERT INTO questions (q_id, project_id, title, created_by, pm_id, related_doc, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
questions.get_questions_by_project: SELECT * FROM questions WHERE project_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC
questions.get_questions_by_project_status: SELECT * FROM questions WHERE project_id = ? AND status = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC
questions.get_questions_by_status: SELECT * FROM questions WHERE status = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC
questions.get_pending_questions: SELECT * FROM questions WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at DESC
questions.get_questions_by_created_by: SELECT * FROM questions WHERE created_by = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC
questions.get_questions_by_pm: SELECT * FROM questions WHERE pm_id = ? AND status = 'pending' ORDER BY created_at DESC
questions.update_question_status: UPDATE questions SET status = ?, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE q_id = ?
questions.update_question_updated_at: UPDATE questions SET updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?
questions.get_next_q_number: SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM questions WHERE q_id LIKE 'Q%'
questions.insert_container_for_doc: INSERT INTO questions (q_id, doc_id, project_id, title, created_by, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'pending', strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
questions.list_open_items_by_project: SELECT q.doc_id, qi.seq, qi.title, d.type_code FROM question_items qi JOIN questions q ON qi.question_id = q.id JOIN documents d ON d.doc_id = q.doc_id LEFT JOIN groups g ON g.group_id = d.group_id WHERE qi.answer_count = 0 AND q.doc_id IS NOT NULL AND (? IS NULL OR q.project_id = ?) AND COALESCE(d.doc_review_status, '') <> 'wf_done' AND COALESCE(UPPER(g.status), '') NOT IN ('CLOSED', 'DISCARDED') AND g.closed_at IS NULL AND g.deleted_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM documents rd WHERE rd.group_id = d.group_id AND ((rd.type_code IN ('R', 'B') AND rd.doc_review_status = 'wf_done') OR rd.type_code = 'DC')) ORDER BY q.updated_at DESC

question_items.insert_question_item: INSERT INTO question_items (question_id, seq, title, body, asker_kind, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
question_items.get_question_items: SELECT * FROM question_items WHERE question_id = ? ORDER BY seq ASC
question_items.get_unanswered_items: SELECT * FROM question_items WHERE question_id = ? AND answer_count = 0 ORDER BY seq ASC
question_items.get_max_seq: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(seq), 0) AS max_seq FROM question_items WHERE question_id = ?
question_items.increment_answer_count: UPDATE question_items SET answer_count = answer_count + 1, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?
question_items.decrement_answer_count: UPDATE question_items SET answer_count = MAX(0, answer_count - 1), updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?
question_items.list_by_doc: SELECT qi.* FROM question_items qi JOIN questions q ON qi.question_id = q.id WHERE q.doc_id = ? ORDER BY qi.seq
question_items.qa_bundle_by_doc: SELECT qi.seq, qi.title, qi.body, qi.asker_kind, a.author_kind, a.body AS answer_body FROM question_items qi JOIN questions q ON qi.question_id = q.id LEFT JOIN answers a ON a.question_item_id = qi.id WHERE q.doc_id = ? ORDER BY qi.seq, a.created_at

answers.insert_answer: INSERT INTO answers (question_item_id, body, author_kind, author_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
answers.get_answers_by_question_item: SELECT * FROM answers WHERE question_item_id = ? ORDER BY created_at ASC
answers.get_answers_by_author: SELECT * FROM answers WHERE author_id = ? ORDER BY created_at DESC
answers.mark_answer_accepted: UPDATE answers SET is_accepted = 1, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?

workflow_sequence_items.get_pending_head_by_group: SELECT wsi.*, ws.id AS seq_id, ws.doc_id AS parent_doc_id, d_result.doc_review_status AS result_doc_review_status FROM workflow_sequence_items wsi JOIN workflow_sequences ws ON wsi.sequence_id = ws.id JOIN documents d ON ws.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN documents d_result ON wsi.result_doc_id = d_result.doc_id WHERE d.group_id = ? AND d.project_id = ? AND wsi.result_doc_id IS NULL ORDER BY wsi.sort_order ASC LIMIT 1

workflow_sequences.insert_sequence: INSERT INTO workflow_sequences (doc_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
workflow_sequences.advance_head: UPDATE workflow_sequences SET head_advanced_at = ?, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?
workflow_sequences.insert_sequence_item: INSERT INTO workflow_sequence_items (sequence_id, item_seq, type, label, doc_class, sort_order, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
workflow_sequences.get_sequence_items: SELECT wsi.id, wsi.sequence_id, wsi.item_seq, wsi.type, wsi.label, wsi.doc_class, wsi.sort_order, wsi.result_doc_id, wsi.created_at, wsi.updated_at, d.doc_review_status AS result_doc_review_status, d.seq AS result_seq, CASE WHEN wsi.result_doc_id IS NULL THEN 'pending' WHEN COALESCE(d.doc_review_status, '') = 'approved' THEN 'done' ELSE 'in_progress' END AS status FROM workflow_sequence_items wsi LEFT JOIN documents d ON wsi.result_doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE wsi.sequence_id = ? ORDER BY wsi.sort_order ASC
workflow_sequences.get_sequence_head: SELECT wsi.*, d.doc_review_status AS result_doc_review_status FROM workflow_sequence_items wsi LEFT JOIN documents d ON wsi.result_doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE wsi.sequence_id = ? AND wsi.result_doc_id IS NULL ORDER BY wsi.sort_order ASC LIMIT 1
workflow_sequences.get_effective_head: SELECT wsi.*, d.doc_review_status AS result_doc_review_status FROM workflow_sequence_items wsi LEFT JOIN documents d ON wsi.result_doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE wsi.sequence_id = ? AND (wsi.result_doc_id IS NULL OR (wsi.type NOT IN ('M') AND COALESCE(d.doc_review_status, '') NOT IN ('approved'))) ORDER BY CASE WHEN wsi.result_doc_id IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC, wsi.sort_order ASC LIMIT 1
workflow_sequences.get_in_progress_head_by_group: SELECT wsi.*, ws.id AS seq_id, ws.doc_id AS parent_doc_id, d_result.doc_review_status AS result_doc_review_status FROM workflow_sequence_items wsi JOIN workflow_sequences ws ON wsi.sequence_id = ws.id JOIN documents d ON ws.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN documents d_result ON wsi.result_doc_id = d_result.doc_id WHERE d.group_id = ? AND d.project_id = ? AND wsi.result_doc_id IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(d_result.doc_review_status, '') NOT IN ('approved') ORDER BY wsi.updated_at DESC LIMIT 1
workflow_sequences.get_pending_head_by_group: SELECT wsi.*, ws.id AS seq_id, ws.doc_id AS parent_doc_id, d_result.doc_review_status AS result_doc_review_status FROM workflow_sequence_items wsi JOIN workflow_sequences ws ON wsi.sequence_id = ws.id JOIN documents d ON ws.doc_id = d.doc_id LEFT JOIN documents d_result ON wsi.result_doc_id = d_result.doc_id WHERE d.group_id = ? AND d.project_id = ? AND wsi.result_doc_id IS NULL ORDER BY wsi.sort_order ASC LIMIT 1
workflow_sequences.get_sequence_head_pending: SELECT wsi.*, d.doc_review_status AS result_doc_review_status FROM workflow_sequence_items wsi LEFT JOIN documents d ON wsi.result_doc_id = d.doc_id WHERE wsi.sequence_id = ? AND wsi.result_doc_id IS NULL ORDER BY wsi.sort_order ASC LIMIT 1
workflow_sequences.delete_pending_items: DELETE FROM workflow_sequence_items WHERE sequence_id = ? AND result_doc_id IS NULL
workflow_sequences.get_max_item_seq: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(item_seq), 0) AS max_seq FROM workflow_sequence_items WHERE sequence_id = ?
workflow_sequences.get_sequence_item_by_result_doc_id: SELECT * FROM workflow_sequence_items WHERE result_doc_id = ? LIMIT 1
workflow_sequences.set_item_result_doc_id: UPDATE workflow_sequence_items SET result_doc_id = ?, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?

workflow_item_results.insert_result: INSERT INTO workflow_item_results (item_id, registered_path, registered_doc_id, status, registered_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'pending_approval', ?, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'), strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now'))
workflow_item_results.get_latest_result_by_item: SELECT * FROM workflow_item_results WHERE item_id = ? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
workflow_item_results.get_pending_result_by_item: SELECT * FROM workflow_item_results WHERE item_id = ? AND status = 'pending_approval' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
workflow_item_results.update_result_status: UPDATE workflow_item_results SET status = ?, reviewed_at = ?, reviewed_by = ?, updated_at = strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ', 'now') WHERE id = ?

messages.list_messages_by_project: SELECT id, project, doc_type, message, updated_at FROM project_messages WHERE project = ? ORDER BY doc_type, updated_at DESC, id ASC
messages.get_messages_for_dialog: SELECT id, project, doc_type, message, updated_at FROM project_messages WHERE project = ? AND doc_type IN (?, '*')
messages.get_message_by_id: SELECT id, project, doc_type, message, updated_at FROM project_messages WHERE id = ?
messages.insert_message: INSERT INTO project_messages (project, doc_type, message, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
messages.update_message: UPDATE project_messages SET doc_type = ?, message = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?

engine_recipes.count_active: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM engine_recipes WHERE status = 'active'
engine_recipes.get_by_id: SELECT id, engine, label, setup, run_example, notes, origin, status, last_success_run_id, last_success_at, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM engine_recipes WHERE id = ?
engine_recipes.get_active_by_engine: SELECT id, engine, label, setup, run_example, notes, origin, status, last_success_run_id, last_success_at, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM engine_recipes WHERE status = 'active' AND engine = ?
engine_recipes.find_by_engine: SELECT id, engine, label, setup, run_example, notes, origin, status, last_success_run_id, last_success_at, updated_by, created_at, updated_at FROM engine_recipes WHERE engine = ?
engine_recipes.insert: INSERT INTO engine_recipes (engine, label, setup, run_example, notes, origin, status, last_success_run_id, last_success_at, updated_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
engine_recipes.update_row: UPDATE engine_recipes SET label = ?, setup = ?, run_example = ?, notes = ?, origin = ?, status = ?, last_success_run_id = ?, last_success_at = ?, updated_by = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?

test_commands.list_active: SELECT id, project, command, description, origin, status, last_success_at, created_at, updated_at FROM project_test_commands WHERE project = ? AND status = 'active' ORDER BY CASE WHEN last_success_at IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ASC, last_success_at DESC, id ASC
test_commands.count_active: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM project_test_commands WHERE project = ? AND status = 'active'
test_commands.get_by_id: SELECT id, project, command, description, origin, status, last_success_at, created_at, updated_at FROM project_test_commands WHERE project = ? AND id = ?
test_commands.find_by_command: SELECT id, project, command, description, origin, status, last_success_at, created_at, updated_at FROM project_test_commands WHERE project = ? AND command = ?
test_commands.insert: INSERT INTO project_test_commands (project, command, description, origin, status, last_success_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
test_commands.update_row: UPDATE project_test_commands SET command = ?, description = ?, origin = ?, status = ?, last_success_at = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE project = ? AND id = ?
